item.title: CVE-2026-62337 · snark-verifier: Halo 2 aggregation circuit mishandles point-at-infinity proof elements
item.description: ### Summary The Halo 2 aggregation circuit could mishandle proof elements encoded as the point at infinity. item.title: CVE-2026-102945 · Aether Project amf: panic on an unrecovered NGAP goroutine
item.description: ## Summary HandlePathSwitchRequest guards the UESecurityCapabilities IE for presence but never for length, and the extensible APER type silently yields an empty bit string, so six unguarded index-zero reads panic on an unrecovered goroutine and terminate the AMF. item.title: CVE-2026-77313 · Flyto2 Core: SSRF guard validates the resolved IP but connects by hostname, allowing DNS-rebinding TOCTOU
